_comment: Reference copy of PicoClaw's configuration schema, installed read-only to
The LIVE configuration is generated on first boot by `picoclaw onboard`
into /etc/picoclaw/config.json. This file exists so an operator can see the
expected shape, especially the channel nesting.
Channel credentials are nested under `settings`, NOT flat. PicoClaw's
Channel.GetDecoded() decodes `settings` into a typed struct such as
config.FeishuSettings, so a flat `token`/`app_id` key is silently ignored.
Never put a real API key or bot token in this file: it ships inside the
firmware image and is published with every release.

model_list._comment: Local Ollama. Switch with: picoclaw model, or set agents.defaults.model_name.

feishu._comment: Feishu/Lark. Set is_lark=true when using the international Lark platform.
